NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 14, 1:01 PM ET

CeeDee Lamb is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 20.6 DraftKings points for $8,800, against San Francisco. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (19.9, $9,300) and Justin Jefferson (17.7, $6,800) are next.

Justin Jefferson returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.60 projected points per $1,000 at $6,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 14, 1:01 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 10

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs SF ($8,800)

CeeDee Lamb carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.6 DraftKings points at $8,800. That is 0.7 points clear of Jaxon Smith-Njigba. The model gives him 11.4 targets on 34.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.34 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 20.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 44.4, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 4.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA at LV ($9,300)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects 2nd at the position with 19.9 DraftKings points at $9,300. The model gives him 8.4 targets on 24.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.14 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.7 and a ceiling of 44.6, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.

Justin Jefferson, MIN at GB ($6,800)

Justin Jefferson projects 3rd at the position with 17.7 DraftKings points at $6,800. The model gives him 9.6 targets on 27.4 routes. The salary works out to 2.60 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 17.6 points with a simulated floor of 4.9 and a ceiling of 42.1, and he holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Minnesota is a 2.5-point underdog on the road against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 20 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Jakobi Meyers, JAX at TEN ($4,200)

Jakobi Meyers projects for 10.4 DraftKings points at $4,200, which works out to 2.47 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 24 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 4.6 targets on 21.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Meyers averaged 10.3 points with a simulated floor of 2.3 and a ceiling of 25.3, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 10.5-point favorite on the road against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 46.5.
